summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (placed after de_skolemize, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper covering the W3C CBD rules: subject triples, recursive blank-node objects guarded by the result-subject check, and reification of every statement whose rdf:subject is the node. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (setUp parses an inline Turtle fixture, tearDown closes the graph) covering rule 1/2 counts, typed/untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node non-expansion in reifiers, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Tests were not run (per instructions), and line lengths were checked by reading only. No commits were made. Test counts were hand-computed from my own fixture, not the spec's reference fixtures.
